subject: website
name: Excalidraw on Swarm
summary: The Excalidraw whiteboard served from Swarm. No public source for this build was found. It is not Level 3: when it opens it loads the Simple Analytics script from scripts.simpleanalyticscdn.com with no integrity hash, third-party code the user has not asked for. It also loads fonts from a DigitalOcean CDN.

connections.name: Simple Analytics (scripts.simpleanalyticscdn.com)
connections.note: Script and tracking pixel loaded when the page opens.

connections.name: Excalidraw font CDN (digitaloceanspaces.com)
connections.note: Fonts fetched when the page opens.
